entries.en: Sun, surf, sand... and geth. I bet they don't put that in the brochure.
Nothing like a nice, relaxing stroll on the beach... blasting bad guys with my boomstick!
I do not know which is worse: the geth, or all this sand in my... never mind.
This world reminds me of where I grew up on Palaven. Minus the geth, of course.
This is my kind of vacation: lots of scenery, and lots of killing!
This world is beautiful. Too bad it's been contaminated by Saren and his geth.
Shadow is on the ground. Repeat: Shadow is on the ground.
Air threat has not materialized! We may be getting some help from Shadow.
Captain Kirrahe's down! Aegohr, form up with Jaeto. Hold that line!
Chief Williams, with Aegohr team! Mannovai, Jaeto teams, move! Time to get some attention!
Ready, Shepard.
On your order, Commander.
On your initiative, Commander Shepard.
They're calling sat-strikes! Jaeto, watch for comm stations! Williams, can you see anything?
Mannovai is under coordinated crossfire. Check for long-range turrets helping the geth target!
Something scrambled their targeting. We've got a shot! Chief Williams, take the heat off Mannovai!
Damn it. We have to move! Anyone left from Mannovai, merge up with Jaeto. Chief Williams, with me.
Lieutenant Alenko, with Aegohr team! Mannovai, Jaeto teams, move! Time to get some attention!
Fire is coordinated on Mannovai team. We can't reach the geth turrets. They're out of range!
Something scrambled their targeting. We've got a shot! Lieutenant Alenko, take the heat off Mannovai!
Damn it. We have to move! Anyone left from Mannovai, merge up with Jaeto. Lieutenant Alenko, with me.
They're calling sat-strikes! Jaeto, watch for comm stations! Alenko, can you see anything?
Aircraft heading to perimeter stations to recharge. Bunker up before they come back!
We're getting pounded! Bunker up before the aircraft return!
Shadow team must be getting close. Hold the line, men! Hold the line!
Holding ground. Jaeto, around me. Shadow team must be getting close.
Comm check. Do you read me, Commander?
Good. We'll start our push. We'll try to make it to the AA guns, but it might be up to you to finish the job.
And Commander? If you see any way to undermine their defenses, we could definitely use the help.
Loud and clear.
It's fine. Let's move.
Affirmative.
Wonder why the geth were protecting that outpost?
The geth obviously don't want us getting near that outpost.
I wonder why the geth were guarding that outpost?
We should see if that outpost has any useful information.
Curious. The geth certainly wanted to keep us away from that outpost.
A geth flyer. It appears to be refueling.
Geth flyer. Looks like it's refueling.
It is a geth flyer that appears to be refueling.
Geth flyer. Looks like its stuck refueling.
Geth flyer. I think it's refueling.
A geth flyer. Looks like it's refueling.
We should take it out before it can go after Chief Williams and the others.
We should take it out before it can go after Lt. Alenko and the others.
Perhaps we should try to disable it before it can return to attack the other teams.
Let's take it out before it can go back and harass the other teams.
Perhaps we should prevent it from attacking the other teams.
We eliminate this base and Saren's going to feel it!
We need to wipe this whole base out!
Let's clear this place out.
I hope we can count on those salarians.
There is something foul in the air here.
This is a place of evil. It needs to be destroyed.
Saren's experiments have to be stopped!
The salarians will do their part. Let's just make sure we do ours.
Saren needs to pay for what he's done to my people.
I'm going to tear this whole place down!
This place is an abomination. Saren's research must be destroyed.
The salarians are counting on us, Shepard. We can't let them down.
